crossRefs.note: Therefore the Lord answered him, “You hypocrites! Doesn’t each one of you free his ox or his donkey from the stall on…
“If you meet your enemy’s ox or his donkey going astray, you shall surely bring it back to him again.
If you see the donkey of him who hates you fallen down under his burden, don’t leave him. You shall surely help him…
“This is the interpretation, O king, and it is the decree of the Most High, which has come on my lord the king:
He said to them, “What man is there among you, who has one sheep, and if this one falls into a pit on the Sabbath day…
Of how much more value then is a man than a sheep! Therefore it is lawful to do good on the Sabbath day.”

translations.web: He answered them, “Which of you, if your son or an ox fell into a well, wouldn’t immediately pull him out on a Sabbath day?”
translations.bsb: And He asked them, “Which of you whose son or ox falls into a pit on the Sabbath day will not immediately pull him out?”
translations.kjv: And answered them, saying, Which of you shall have an ass or an ox fallen into a pit, and will not straightway pull him out on the sabbath day?
translations.asv: And he said unto them, Which of you shall have an ass or an ox fallen into a well, and will not straightway draw him up on a sabbath day?
